svg.title: RoPE makes attention depend on relative position
svg.desc: Rotary positional embeddings rotate query and key dimensions by angles determined by token position, making their dot product depend on relative displacement.

g.text: RoPE makes attention depend on relative position
Rotate query and key pairs by their positions; their dot product depends on the offset.
ROTATE Q AND K · DOT PRODUCT KEEPS RELATIVE OFFSET
Pairs of dimensions rotate at different fixed frequencies; no learned position table.
